title: Runtime event envelope
description:
Every event flowing plugin -> runtime -> consumer.

`correlationId` and `idempotencyKey` are both required because delivery is at-least-once: without them a reconnect replays an interaction's history and re-fires every trigger attached to it.

source.description: Origin subsystem: a plugin id (`aokie`) or a runtime subsystem (`desktop`, `flows`, `services`).

correlationId.description: Shared by every event of one logical interaction.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies THIS occurrence. Consumers dedupe on it.

data.description: Event payload. May contain PII and MUST be minimised by the producer — the runtime does not sanitise it.
